facts.fact: The director general of the state company SDIN (Societe nationale de developpement des infrastructures numeriques) said at its HQ inauguration that it operates a national optical fibre network of more than 1,760 km on three main axes linking the country's regions; reported by AMI. The statement is dated 2025-12-16, the document's date.

systems.owner: Societe nationale de developpement des infrastructures numeriques (SDIN)
